name: OneWeb (Eutelsat LTEF)
skipReason: A2.4 OneWeb: gate BLOCKED on the LTEF decode. OneWeb's operator feed is LTEF, a proprietary 17-column fixed-point encoding with no public column spec (A2.2c-1 finding); SMA/eccentricity/frame are not decodable, so no raw state vectors can be fit for a hard RMS gate. Any element-space check vs CelesTrak's OneWeb-E OMM would be non-independent anyway (CelesTrak's SupGP derives from the same LTEF). OWNER-ASSIST: obtain OneWeb's LTEF spec. The captured CelesTrak OneWeb-E SupGP (2026-07-13, 651 objects) is checked in as a reference pair for when the decode is unblocked.

tolerances.note: No running gate. See skipReason. Captured OneWeb-E SupGP: 651 objects (LEO, ~i87.9deg, ~n13.16 rev/day).
